hamiltonian: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + 0.1 sum_i X_i, round-1 manifests unchanged
untested: KM-gamma_l (per-layer gamma with shared theta shape): not run in this round
parametrization: same circuits as round 1. Shared families optimized in linear coefficients (a, b, c) = (gamma, gamma*theta_K, gamma*theta_M); QAOA in (gamma_l, beta_l). A shared-gamma circuit with only c0 set is shared-gamma QAOA (w1 = sum X).
box: every diagonal coefficient (a, b, c, and each QAOA gamma_l) in [-2pi/s_J, 2pi/s_J], s_J = sqrt(mean_i sum_j J_ij^2); shell controls and QAOA beta in [-2pi, 2pi]. Round-1 box was (-12, 12) in product coordinates.
optimizer: L-BFGS-B, analytic adjoint gradient, one evaluation = one energy+gradient call

L1.grid: 16 values u = pi j/16 (a = u/s_J, a >= 0 sign canonical) times grid_c0, other controls zero; energy-only; identical points for all families
L1.random_crn_starts: 8 for shared families, 9 for QAOA; draws from SeedSequence([20261117, N, k, L, s]) shared across families
L1.round1_best: re-optimized from the round-1 selected angles mapped to linear coordinates and clipped to the box
L1.nested: K from best r2 nodata at the same L (b = 0); KM from best r2 K at the same L (c = 0)

L_ge_2.beam: top 3 distinct (|dE| > 1e-6 or |dx| > 0.1) round-2 results at L-1, energy order

selection: lowest energy over all round-2 starts and the round-1 selected state of the cell. Fidelity, eigenvectors and E0 are never used for training, starts, beam or selection.
primary_metric: F_sub: weight of the selected state in the eigenspace within 1e-6 of E0, all N
secondary_metrics: F_even (even X-parity sector ground state; the circuit lives in the even sector)
F_single (eigh column 0, arbitrary inside a degenerate doublet)
converged_flag: best energy reached by >= 2 starts within 1e-6 and fewer than half the starts capped
claim_rule: reliable equal-layer advantage of a shared-gamma family over QAOA only if, at each N and at both L=5 and L=6, F_sub(family) >= F_sub(QAOA) + 0.05 in at least 3 of 4 instances with both cells converged and family energy not worse. KM is the primary comparison; K is reported under the same rule. Otherwise: no reliable advantage.
job_order: N=12 k0..3 first, then N=9, then N=6; one process per (N, k); inside a job L ascending, families nodata, K, KM, qaoa
truncation: deadline checked before each start; truncated cells reported as incomplete
stop: single round; no re-tuning after viewing round-2 fidelities
